_comment: Declarative patch list applied by apply.ps1 to a Strata Terminal install.
Each patch is all-or-nothing: either its anchor is found and the snippet inserted,
or it reports why and changes nothing.
marker: must appear in the file exactly once when the patch is applied; used to
detect 'already applied' and to revert without a backup.
anchor: the exact line the snippet is inserted AFTER (indent included).
file:   path relative to the Terminal root (the folder holding strata.py).

patches.title: Cap the GPU power limit while a model serves
patches.why: The USB display and keyboard dropped on this PC whenever the card stepped from idle to full load.

patches.title: Restore the GPU power limit on `strata launch --stop`
patches.why: Stopping the model should undo the cap the launch applied.

patches.title: Show common commands when `strata` is typed with no arguments
patches.why: argparse's 'the following arguments are required: command' names none of the commands.
patches.insert_before: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:

new_files.title: UAC elevation helper for nvidia-smi
new_files.why: Setting the limit needs administrator rights; this asks for them through the normal Windows prompt.
new_files.marker: def ask_for_admin(want: int, index: int | None = None)
